title: ID0414550-DC/Si-D/PL-[Multiple] StartTransaction sent a summed rather than a value of 0
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The charging station in StartTransaction (MeterSatrt) sent a summed rather than a value of 0. The value “0” was standard for software up to 6.0.3. The summed value was only sent for stations with DC LEM meters. Actually this messes up communication in the backend connection.
Root cause:
Solution:
The reported behavior is intended and compliant to the OCPP standard. Charger cannot change this
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: Active
Child case created-
0414690-→Updated

additional_info.subject: Note to L2
additional_info.body:
As discussed with ES-
It is a standard  conformance behaviour. Energy consumption of a Transaction must be calculated from the difference between MeterStop - MeterStart.
Also created child ticket-0414690

additional_info.subject: Note from child case
additional_info.body: Konrad Frach confirmed the Backend is now able to process the metervalues correctly. No activities on charger side
